parameters.query:
SELECT
  l.id                  AS lead_id,
  l.email,
  l.email_domain,
  l.first_name,
  l.last_name,
  l.full_name,
  l.company,
  l.title,
  l.source,
  l.status              AS lead_status,
  lb.brief              AS brief,
  lb.raw_enrichment     AS raw_enrichment,
  c.id                  AS company_id,
  c.domain              AS company_domain,
  c.industry,
  c.sub_industry,
  c.employee_count,
  c.annual_revenue,
  c.country,
  c.city,
  c.company_type,
  c.tech_stack,
  c.funding_raised
FROM leads l
LEFT JOIN lead_briefs lb ON lb.lead_id = l.id
LEFT JOIN companies  c  ON c.id = l.company_id
WHERE l.id = $1
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  cc.id             AS config_id,
  cc.client_id,
  cc.icp_config,
  cc.scoring_weights,
  cc.tier_thresholds
FROM client_configs cc
JOIN workers w ON w.client_id = cc.client_id
WHERE w.worker_type = 'agent-x'
ORDER BY cc.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE leads
SET
  icp_score       = $1,
  icp_tier        = $2,
  score_breakdown = $3::jsonb,
  status          = 'scored',
  updated_at      = NOW()
WHERE id = $4
RETURNING id, icp_score, icp_tier, status;

INSERT INTO activities (type, lead_id, payload, created_at)
VALUES ('lead_scored', $1, $2::jsonb, NOW());

INSERT INTO worker_events (worker_id, event_type, payload, created_at)
VALUES (
  (SELECT id FROM workers WHERE worker_type = 'agent-x' LIMIT 1),
  'lead.disqualified',
  $1::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO worker_events (worker_id, event_type, payload, created_at)
VALUES (
  (SELECT id FROM workers WHERE worker_type = 'agent-x' LIMIT 1),
  'lead.scored',
  $1::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id;
